articles.summary: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., June 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. (Nasdaq: SUNS) (“SUNS” or the “Company”), a lender on the Tannenbaum Capital Group (“TCG”) Real Estate platform, today announced its dividend for the quarter ending June 30, 2026.
articles.title: Sunrise Realty Trust Announces Dividend for the Second Quarter 2026
